item.title: AI research lab NeoCognition lands $40M seed to build agents that learn like humans
item.description: Founded by an OSU researcher, the startup is developing AI agents that can become experts in any domain.

item.title: ChatGPT’s new Images 2.0 model is surprisingly good at generating text
item.description: ChatGPT Images 2.0, the newest image-generation model from OpenAI, shows just how much AI capabilities have evolved over the last few years.

item.title: Sam Altman throws shade at Anthropic’s cyber model, Mythos: ‘fear-based marketing’
item.description: The AI industry's mudslinging continues.

item.title: Clarifai deletes 3 million photos that OkCupid provided to train facial recognition AI, report says
item.description: The photo deletion comes after an FTC settlement with Clarifai. The company had asked OkCupid — whose executives had invested in Clarifai — to share data in 2014, according to court documents.

item.title: AI Dungeon maker Latitude unveils Voyage, a platform for creating AI-powered RPGs
item.description: Latitude's new AI-native platform, Voyage, aims to help gamers create their very own role-playing game.

item.title: Bond, a new social media platform, wants to use AI to help you kick your doomscrolling habit
item.description: Bond wants you to get off the couch and get back into the real world, its creator says. The new platform's AI system is designed to motivate users to do things away from the app.

item.title: YouTube expands its AI likeness detection technology to celebrities
item.description: YouTube is expanding its AI likeness detection tool to celebrities, giving talent and their reps a way to find and remove deepfakes.

item.title: GRAI believes AI can make music more social, not replace artists
item.description: AI music startup GRAI says fans want to remix tracks, not generate songs from scratch.

item.title: Anthropic takes $5B from Amazon and pledges $100B in cloud spending in return
item.description: Amazon has made another circular AI deal: It's investing another $5 billion in Anthropic. Anthropic has agreed to spend $100 billion on AWS in return.

item.title: Google rolls out Gemini in Chrome in APAC countries
item.description: Google is rolling out Gemini in Chrome in Australia, Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Singapore, South Korea, and Vietnam. The company is rolling this feature out to both desktop and iOS in all of these countries except Japan.

item.title: It’s not just one thing — it’s another thing
item.description: This sentence construction ("It's not just this — it's that") has become so common in AI-generated writing that it's no longer just a clue that a piece of writing may be synthetic — it's almost a guarantee.

item.title: NSA spies are reportedly using Anthropic’s Mythos, despite Pentagon feud
item.description: NSA is said to be using Anthropic's restricted Mythos AI model.

item.title: CEO and CFO suddenly depart AI nuclear power upstart Fermi
item.description: The startup, co-founded by former U.S. Energy Secretary Rick Perry, has faced headwinds with its AI campus in Texas.

item.title: OpenAI’s existential questions
item.description: On the latest episode of Equity, we discuss OpenAI's latest acquisitions and whether they address "two big existential problems" for the company.

item.title: The 12-month window
item.description: A lot of AI startups exist partly because the foundation models haven't expanded into their category yet. As many jokingly acknowledge, that won't last forever.

item.title: Palantir posts mini-manifesto denouncing inclusivity and ‘regressive’ cultures
item.description: Palantir's ideological bent has come under more scrutiny as it's worked with ICE and positioned itself as a defender of "the West."

item.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Uber enters its assetmaxxing era
item.description: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, how AI is playing a part.

item.title: Tesla brings its robotaxi service to Dallas and Houston
item.description: The company now offers robotaxi service in three cities, all of them in Texas, after launching in Austin last year and starting to offer rides without safety drivers in January 2026.

item.title: AI chip startup Cerebras files for IPO
item.description: In recent months, the company announced an agreement with Amazon Web Services to use Cerebras chips in Amazon data centers, as well as a deal with OpenAI reportedly worth more than $10 billion.

item.title: Anthropic’s relationship with the Trump administration seems to be thawing
item.description: Despite recently being designated a supply-chain risk by the Pentagon, Anthropic is still talking to high-level members of the Trump administration.
